title: Google Play App Details Scraper
description: Get Google Play app details with developer, rating, review totals, downloads, category, permissions, and media links. Batch package names by country.

apps.title: Google Play product IDs
apps.description: Google Play product IDs or app package names to look up.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: Google Play product id. For apps this is the package name.

url.title: Url
url.description: Public source page URL used to retrieve this record.

gl.title: Gl
gl.description: Country code for the storefront (2 letters, e.g. us, de).

store.title: Store
store.description: Google Play store vertical: apps, movies, tv, books, or audiobooks. Accepted values: apps, movies, tv, books, audiobooks.

season_id.title: Season Id
season_id.description: TV season id for Google Play TV products.

all_reviews.title: All Reviews
all_reviews.description: Request Google Play review-expanded product pages when available.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Review platform filter, such as phone, tablet, tv, chromebook, watch, or car. Accepted values: phone, tablet, tv, chromebook, watch, car.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Review rating filter from 1 to 5. Accepted values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Review sort mode, such as 1, 2, 3, most_relevant, newest, or rating. Accepted values: 1, 2, 3, most_relevant, newest, rating.

num.title: Num
num.description: Requested review result count for clients that need SerpApi-compatible parameters.

next_page_token.title: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: Review pagination token for clients that need SerpApi-compatible parameters.
